key.name: theme
key.description: Directory name of the theme under the themes search path.

key.name: theme-path
key.description: Searched before the bundled themes. Empty means only bundled themes and ~/.local/share/platter/themes.

key.name: placement
key.description: desktop: behind windows, like the original. floating: above everything.

key.name: anchor
key.summary: Which corner the widget is measured from
key.description: Offsets are from this corner, so the widget keeps its place when the resolution changes or a monitor is unplugged.

key.name: position-x
key.summary: Offset from the anchor corner, horizontally

key.name: position-y
key.summary: Offset from the anchor corner, vertically

key.name: scale
key.summary: Scale factor applied to the whole theme canvas

key.name: hide-when-stopped
key.summary: Hide entirely when nothing is playing

key.name: preferred-player
key.summary: Bus name suffix of the player to follow
key.description: Empty follows whichever player is playing, preferring the most recently active.

key.name: show-when-no-player
key.summary: Stay visible when no MPRIS player is running at all
